opportunities.title: Get pediatric primary care for babies, children, and teens in San Francisco
opportunities.description: Mission Neighborhood Health Center (MNHC) offers primary care for babies, children, and teens. Services include routine health visits, full scope immunization services for children ages 0 -18, acute/“sick” visits, chronic care for pediatric diseases, Infant Health Intervention Program (IHIP), adolescent health services, coordination of specialty services and community resource referrals, and dental referrals. MNHC also offers Nutritionist and Behavioral Health professionals specialized in caring for children and teens.

properties.cost-note: Patients can ask about discounts based on income if ineligible for coverage on other programs. No one is denied care due to inability to pay.
